title: Deletes in Setup use the browser's native confirm() (position delete) or say "Are you sure you want to delete this record?" without naming the grant — one styled confirm that names what is removed and from whom (hotcrm#2194 T2-U10)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 删除岗位用的是浏览器原生确认框；删除记录时只问「确定删除这条记录吗」，不说删的是哪条授权、属于谁。
- **要做：** 统一用一种有样式的确认框，写明删除的是什么、从谁那里移除。
- **完成标准：** 这两类删除都用样式化确认框并点名对象。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U10**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Pages / persona:** metadata delete and related lists in Setup, the system administrator.
- **Now:** position delete uses the browser's native `confirm()`; record deletes say "Delete record — Are you sure you want to delete this record?" without naming the grant.
- **Cost:** native dialogs differ from the 20+ styled ones met elsewhere, and the record confirm does not say what goes.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-10; [`07-people-users-permset-delete-confirm.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-people-users-permset-delete-confirm.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

Read on objectui `origin/main` `74ebad09`, native `confirm()` in the Setup surfaces:
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` ~:1895 (the metadata delete), ~:1996; `MetadataTypeActions.tsx` ~:128; `ResourceHistoryPage.tsx` ~:190; `datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` ~:304; `PackagesPage.tsx` ~:806 (that one is R2-T2-U06's card).
- The record delete's generic sentence comes from the shared record delete confirm; the record's title is available there.

## Done when

- Metadata and record deletes in Setup use the styled confirm, and its sentence names the item (and, for a grant, the user it is removed from).
- No native `confirm()` remains on these delete paths (a test or a grep pin).

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `confirm`, `delete`. 1 open hit: #13183 (bulk-action `confirmText` holes), a different surface; the closed hits (#13154, #13107, #13116 and others) are bulk confirms and other dialogs. **New.**
